detail: Cross-classified AIDS reporting-delay counts (y) by diagnosis date and delay; help page names no grouping factor, a fixed-effects count/reporting-delay table.
Leukaemia remission survival, 23 patients; group is a 2-level fixed treatment comparison (maintenance chemo vs not), no random grouping factor.
Body-temperature readings every 10 min for a single beaver on one day; one time series, no replication across beavers.
Populations of 49 US cities in 1920 (u) and 1930 (x); paired measurements for ratio estimation, no grouping factor.
Spatial point pattern: x,y positions of bramble canes with an age class; coordinates are not groups and there is no response.
Aggregated person-year rate table (deaths y, person-years n) by 5 age groups x smoke; fixed-effects Poisson rate model, no random grouping.
Spatial point pattern: x,y positions of muscle caveolae; coordinates only, no response or grouping factor.
Retirement-centre survival data, 462 residents one row each; sex is a fixed covariate, no random grouping factor.
The city data frame is the first 10 observations of boot bigcity (same source).
37 women one row each: DNA genetic measurement vs handedness score; a bivariate regression, no grouping.
32 cloth rolls: flaw count y vs roll length x (negative-binomial GLM example); one row per roll, no random grouping.
7 dogs one row each: cardiac oxygen vs ventricular pressure; no grouping factor.
Down's syndrome incidence (cases r of m births) across 30 maternal-age categories; binomial regression on age, no random grouping.
11 hybrid ducks one row each: plumage vs behaviour indices; no grouping factor.
Balsam-fir seedling counts on a 5x10 quadrat grid; row and col are plot coordinates, not groups (Census coordinate rule).
Head length/breadth of brother pairs in 25 families, wide format (l1,b1,l2,b2); the family grouping is not a column and there is no single response.
The grav data frame is experiments 7 and 8, a subset of boot gravity (same NBS source).
PET-film accelerated life test: failure time vs voltage at 4 stress levels with censoring; voltage is a fixed stress covariate, no random grouping.
205 melanoma patients one row each, survival/logistic prognostic modelling; no random grouping factor.
MASS mcycle with replicate time values removed plus two added residual-variance-strata columns; a derived table.
Reproductive-toxicity dose response; the three broods per animal are wide columns (brood1/2/3), conc is a dose covariate, no grouping column in the loaded table.
53 prostate-cancer patients one row each: binary nodal involvement r vs clinical predictors (logistic regression); no random grouping.
32 nuclear power plants one row each: construction cost regression on plant covariates; no grouping factor.
3x4 completely randomized factorial (poison x treatment), 4 animals per cell; both factors are fixed treatments with no blocking factor (Box-Cox example).
27 cancer patients one row each (m all 1): remission indicator r vs cell activity LI, logistic regression; no random grouping.
Biweekly salinity regression on lagged salinity, seasonal period factor and river discharge; a single spring time series with an autoregressive term, no random grouping.
79 urine specimens one row each: crystal-presence indicator r vs physical measurements (logistic regression); no grouping factor.

National aggregate US mortality rates: a Status x Sex x Cause full-factorial table with one age-adjusted rate per cell; the factors are fixed classifications with no replication, and (unlike USRegionalMortality) no Region grouping unit. Help page gives only dotplot examples.
Daily NYC ozone, solar radiation, temperature and wind, all continuous; a single-series multiple regression, no grouping factor.
